text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said on Thursday it has reorganized its exploration and production activities around the company's business processes.

The oil and gas exploration company said its existing divisional structure will be replaced with an organization consisting of six separate business units: management of producing properties and operations; domestic exploration; international exploration, including Venezuela; Algeria; marketing; and property acquisitions and divestitures.

It said four of the six business units - producing properties, domestic exploration, international exploration, and property acquisitions and divestitures - will be conducted out of Houston, where the company has an existing office.
In addition to corporate headquarters, all financial and administrative activities, corporate reserves, planning and marketing units will remain in New Orleans.
It is anticipated that about 35 professionals and support staff will be relocated to Houston in the first half of 1997, LL&E said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
